title: NFTreasure
description:
Welcome to the NFTreasure hunt! Try to solve the riddles to win an epic one of a kind NFT Artwork. If you find any clues, go to http://nftreasurehunt.info/

****The game is fully implemented in testnet, however after the hackathon we disabled functionality. We'll make a few tweaks to our implementation and we hope its going live to the ETH main net in the future.****
how_its_made: Solidity, Smart Contracts, IPFS, Cryptography, OpenSea API, Photoshop, Illustrator, Embedded Creativity, Riddles, Proof of Commitment, Democratizing Auctions through proof of commitment tasks instead of plain money.
